page.overview:
Who is Joshua Jae?

Commodore Joshua Jae was a Starfleet flag officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, he was serving in the Starfleet Mission Operations Division. Sometime in that year, he sent an order about Romulan Neutral Zone patrol assignments to Captain of the and Captain Asenath Hammond of the . (, okudagram)
